Sienna LuProduct Designer

What has always driven me is a curiosity about people and the systems they interact with. I'm fascinated by how people think, make decisions, and navigate complexity, and how thoughtful design can make those experiences feel more natural.

4 case studies

I’m a Product Designer with 8+ years in fintech. I started in visual and UI design, then grew a design team from one to eleven as Design Manager at Akulaku, a Southeast Asian fintech company. That experience led me to study Business Enterprise at the University of Warwick, and today I look at every product through three perspectives: business, user and information.

Perspectives

  • Business: why the product exists, and how it creates value.
  • User: what people are trying to do, and what gets in their way when they decide.
  • Information: how to turn complex options and processes into something people can act on with confidence.

I’ve applied this across fintech, B2B SaaS and my own product, TalkFlow, which I built from research to MVP.
